Limitations

  • The QUBO is a degree-2 surrogate for the Turner model; loop terms that depend on which other helices are selected are approximated, not exact.
  • Gates B and C require exact enumeration and are indeterminate above 22 variables.
  • Candidate generation can exclude the true structure, which caps accuracy before any solver runs. Gate A reports that ceiling.
  • A stem-indexed QUBO cannot represent dangling-end terms at any penalty setting, since they attach to unpaired context rather than to any stem.
  • Crossing (pseudoknotted) structures cannot be scored by ViennaRNA; their FoldQ energy is reported as not scorable rather than a number.
  • This is a research prototype, not a clinical or therapeutic-design tool.
  • No quantum-advantage claim is made or implied.
